en.t: Odo is crowned king of West Francia at Compiègne
en.s: On February 29, 888, Odo was crowned king of West Francia by Walter, archbishop of Sens, at Compiègne in present-day France. A second coronation at Reims followed in November.

zh.t: 厄德在贡比涅加冕为西法兰克国王
zh.s: 888年2月29日，桑斯大主教瓦尔特在今法国贡比涅为厄德加冕，立其为西法兰克国王。同年11月，他又在兰斯举行第二次加冕。

en.s: The Battle of Lucocisterna (or Lutocisterna) was fought February 29, 1324, during the Aragonese conquest of Sardinia, between the army of the Crown of Aragon, in command of the Infante Alfonso IV of Aragon, son of King James II of Aragon, and the army of the Republic of Pisa led by Manfredi della Gherardesca, count of Donoratico.

zh.t: 卢科奇斯泰尔纳战役
zh.s: 1324年2月29日，阿拉贡征服撒丁岛期间，双方在卢科奇斯泰尔纳交战。阿拉贡王冠领军队由国王海梅二世之子、王子阿方索，也就是后来的阿方索四世指挥；比萨共和国军队由多诺拉蒂科伯爵曼弗雷迪·德拉盖拉尔代斯卡指挥。该地名也有卢托奇斯泰尔纳的拼写。

en.t: Columbus uses a predicted lunar eclipse to obtain provisions in Jamaica
en.s: On February 29, 1504, while stranded in Jamaica, Christopher Columbus used his prediction of a lunar eclipse to pressure local people into supplying his expedition with provisions.

zh.t: 哥伦布利用月食预报向牙买加当地居民索取补给
zh.s: 1504年2月29日，被困牙买加的克里斯托弗·哥伦布利用预报中的月食，迫使当地居民为其探险队提供补给。

loc: 今美国马萨诸塞州迪尔菲尔德

en.t: French and Indigenous forces raid Deerfield
en.s: A force of French soldiers and allied Indigenous warriors attacked the English colonial settlement of Deerfield in Massachusetts Bay before dawn on February 29. Snowdrifts helped raiders cross the village palisade. The attackers burned buildings, killed colonists and took more than a hundred captives on a long march toward Montreal. Some captives were later ransomed; others joined Mohawk families. The raid formed part of Queen Anne's War and reflected a wider struggle along the contested frontier of New France and New England. Its memory has since been shaped by different colonial, French and Indigenous accounts of the conflict.

zh.t: 法国与原住民联军突袭迪尔菲尔德
zh.s: 2月29日黎明前，法国士兵及结盟的原住民战士，袭击马萨诸塞湾的英国殖民定居点迪尔菲尔德。积雪帮助袭击者越过村庄木栅栏。他们焚毁建筑、杀害殖民者，并带走一百多名俘虏，长途押往蒙特利尔。部分俘虏后来获赎回，另一些则加入莫霍克家庭。此次袭击属于安妮女王战争，反映新法兰西与新英格兰争议边境上更广泛的斗争。殖民者、法国人与原住民的不同记述，也塑造了后人对这场冲突的认识。

en.t: Ulrika Eleonora, Queen of Sweden abdicates in favour of her husband, who becomes King Frederick I on March 24
en.s: Ulrika Eleonora or Ulrica Eleanor (23 January 1688 – 24 November 1741), also known as Ulrika Eleonora the Younger, was Queen of Sweden from 5 December 1718 until her abdication on 29 February 1720 in favour of Frederick, her husband. Upon his accession, as King Frederick I, she served as his queen consort until her death on 24 November 1741.

zh.t: 瑞典女王乌尔丽卡·埃莉诺拉退位，由丈夫继位成为腓特烈一世国王
zh.s: 乌尔丽卡·埃莉诺拉（又作乌尔丽卡·埃莉诺；1688年1月23日—1741年11月24日），又称小乌尔丽卡·埃莉诺拉，自1718年12月5日起担任瑞典女王。1720年2月29日，她让位给丈夫腓特烈。腓特烈继位成为腓特烈一世后，她以王后身份与他共同执政，直至1741年11月24日去世。

loc: 波多利亚巴尔，今属乌克兰

en.t: Polish nobles establish the Bar Confederation
en.s: Polish nobles adopted the founding act of the Bar Confederation in the town of Bar, Podolia, on February 29. The armed association opposed Russian influence in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and defended the political privileges of the nobility and the Catholic faith.

zh.t: 波兰贵族成立巴尔联盟
zh.s: 2月29日，波兰贵族在波多利亚的巴尔镇通过巴尔联盟的成立文件。这个武装联盟反对俄罗斯影响波兰立陶宛联邦，并捍卫贵族政治特权及天主教信仰。

en.s: The Treaty of Amity, Commerce, and Navigation, Between His Britannic Majesty and the United States of America, commonly known as the Jay Treaty, and also as Jay's Treaty, was a 1794 treaty between the United States and Great Britain that averted war, resolved issues remaining since the 1783 Treaty of Paris (which ended the American Revolutionary War), and facilitated ten years of peaceful trade between Americans and the British in the midst of the French Revolutionary Wars, which had begun in 1792.
en.n: The Jay Treaty between the United States and Great Britain comes into force, facilitating ten years of peaceful trade between the two nations.

zh.t: 杰伊条约
zh.s: 《友好、通商和航海条约》是大不列颠国王与美利坚合众国之间于1794年签订的条约，通常称为《杰伊条约》。该条约避免了战争，解决了1783年《巴黎条约》（结束美国独立战争）后遗留的问题，并在1792年爆发的法国大革命战争期间，为美国人与英国人之间的和平贸易提供了十年保障。
zh.n: 美国与英国之间的《杰伊条约》生效，为两国提供了十年的和平贸易。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 29 February and 14 March 1852, electing the first legislature of the French Second Empire. Emperor Napoleon III's Bonapartists won a huge majority consisting of 258 of the 261 seats (five Royalists allied with the Bonapartists). The Party of Order that had won a majority in the 1849 election was banned following their opposition to the 1851 coup by President Louis Napoleon Bonaparte.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1852年法国立法选举
zh.s: 法国于1852年2月29日和3月14日举行议会选举，选出法兰西第二帝国第一届立法机关。拿破仑三世的波拿巴派赢得261席中的258席，取得压倒性多数，另有5名保王派与波拿巴派结盟。曾在1849年选举中赢得多数的秩序党因反对路易-拿破仑·波拿巴总统1851年的政变而遭取缔。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的首轮投票日期。

en.t: Union cavalry raids a Confederate camp at Rio Hill
en.s: On February 29, 1864, Union cavalry under George A. Custer raided a Confederate camp at Rio Hill near Charlottesville, Virginia, United States. The operation formed part of a diversion from a separate raid toward Richmond.

zh.t: 联邦骑兵突袭里奥山的南军营地
zh.s: 1864年2月29日，乔治·A.卡斯特率联邦骑兵突袭美国弗吉尼亚州夏洛茨维尔附近里奥山的南军营地。这次行动旨在为另一支前往里士满的突袭部队分散注意力。

en.t: First and second battles of El Teb
en.s: The first and second battles of El Teb (4 February 1884 and 29 February 1884) took place during the British Sudan Campaign where a force of Sudanese under Osman Digna won a victory over a 3,500 strong Egyptian force under the command of General Valentine Baker which was marching to relieve Tokar on the 4th.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 埃尔特布第一次和第二次战役
zh.s: 埃尔特布第一次和第二次战役分别发生于1884年2月4日和2月29日，属于英国苏丹战役。奥斯曼·迪格纳率领的苏丹军队击败了由瓦伦丁·贝克将军指挥、人数达3,500人的埃及军队。埃及军队于2月4日出发，原计划前往解救托卡尔。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Virginia establishes the school that becomes James Madison University
en.s: On February 29, 1908, Virginia’s legislature established the State Normal and Industrial School for Women at Harrisonburg, Virginia, United States. The institution later became James Madison University.

zh.t: 弗吉尼亚州设立詹姆斯麦迪逊大学的前身
zh.s: 1908年2月29日，美国弗吉尼亚州议会在哈里森堡设立州立女子师范与工业学校。该校后来发展为詹姆斯麦迪逊大学。

en.s: The action of 29 February 1916 was a naval engagement fought during the First World War between the United Kingdom and the German Empire. SMS Greif, a German commerce raider, broke out into the North Sea and Admiral Sir John Jellicoe dispatched Royal Navy warships to intercept the raider. Four British vessels intercepted the commerce raider Greif.

zh.t: 1916年2月29日海战
zh.s: 1916年2月29日海战是第一次世界大战期间英国与德意志帝国之间的一场海战。德国商船袭击舰“格赖夫”号突围进入北海后，约翰·杰利科爵士海军上将派出皇家海军舰艇拦截。四艘英国舰艇截住了“格赖夫”号。

en.s: The Czechoslovak Constitution of 1920 was the first permanent constitution of Czechoslovakia. Ratified after World War I, the constitution established Czechoslovakia as a democratic republic. It was adopted by the National Assembly on 29 February 1920 and replaced the provisional constitution adopted on 13 November 1918. The constitution, modelled after constitutions of established democracies, was conceived in the light of Hans Kelsen's contribution to constitutional law.

zh.t: 1920年捷克斯洛伐克宪法
zh.s: 1920年捷克斯洛伐克宪法是捷克斯洛伐克的第一部永久宪法。宪法在第一次世界大战后获批准，确立了捷克斯洛伐克民主共和国体制。1920年2月29日，国民议会通过这部宪法，取代1918年11月13日通过的临时宪法。宪法参考了成熟民主国家的宪法，并吸收了汉斯·凯尔森对宪法法律的贡献。

en.s: The second battle of Tembien was fought on the northern front of the Second Italo-Ethiopian War. This battle consisted of attacks by Italian forces under Marshal Pietro Badoglio on Ethiopian forces under Ras Kassa Haile Darge and Ras Seyoum Mangasha. This battle, which resulted in a decisive defeat of Ethiopian forces, was primarily fought in the area around the Tembien Province.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 第二次坦比恩战役
zh.s: 第二次坦比恩战役发生在第二次意大利-埃塞俄比亚战争北线。彼得罗·巴多格里奥元帅指挥的意大利军队进攻卡萨·海尔·达尔格亲王和塞尤姆·曼加沙亲王率领的埃塞俄比亚军队。埃塞俄比亚军队遭到决定性失败，战斗主要发生在坦比恩省周边地区。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The February 26 coup attempt collapses in Tokyo
en.s: On February 29, 1936, rebel soldiers in Tokyo, Japan, surrendered after the army moved against them, bringing the February 26 coup attempt to an end.

zh.t: 日本二二六兵变结束
zh.s: 1936年2月29日，日本东京的叛军在军队包围镇压下投降，二二六兵变结束。

en.s: The 1940 Hong Kong municipal election was held on 29 February 1940 for the one of the 2 unofficial seats in the Urban Council of Hong Kong. It was the first contested election since the establishment of the Urban Council of Hong Kong and also the last one before the outbreak of the Pacific War. The next election to be held would be the 1952 election, twelve years later.

zh.t: 1940年香港市政选举
zh.s: 1940年2月29日，香港举行市政选举，选出市政局两个非官守议席中的一席。这是市政局成立后首次有竞争的选举，也是太平洋战争爆发前最后一次。下一次选举直到12年后的1952年才举行。

loc: 美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶

en.t: The 12th Academy Awards honor Hattie McDaniel
en.s: The 12th Academy Awards took place at the Ambassador Hotel in Los Angeles on February 29. Hattie McDaniel won the supporting actress award for Gone with the Wind, becoming the first Black performer to win a competitive Academy Award. The film won eight awards, including Best Picture.

zh.t: 海蒂·麦克丹尼尔在第12届奥斯卡获奖
zh.s: 第12届奥斯卡颁奖典礼于2月29日在洛杉矶大使酒店举行。海蒂·麦克丹尼尔凭《乱世佳人》获得最佳女配角奖，成为首位获得奥斯卡竞赛奖项的黑人演员。该片共赢得八项奖，包括最佳影片。

en.t: Finland agrees in principle to negotiate on Soviet peace terms
en.s: On February 29, 1940, Finland’s government accepted Soviet peace terms in principle and agreed to enter negotiations during the Winter War. The war did not end that day; the peace treaty followed in March.

zh.t: 芬兰原则上接受苏联和谈条件
zh.s: 1940年2月29日，芬兰政府在冬季战争期间原则上接受苏联提出的和平条件，并同意进入谈判。战争并未在当天结束，和平条约随后于3月达成。

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1944 was held in two rounds on January 18 and February 29, 1944. Like most Southern states between Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party was virtually nonexistent in terms of electoral support. This meant that the two Democratic Party primaries held on these dates were the real contest over who would be governor. The 1944 election saw the reformer ‘anti-Long’ faction retain power for another four years under Jimmie Davis. Louisiana's constitution did not allow incumbent governor Sam Jones to succeed himself in a consecutive term.

zh.t: 1944年路易斯安那州州长选举
zh.s: 1944年路易斯安那州州长选举的两轮投票分别于1月18日和2月29日举行。从重建时期到民权运动时代，路易斯安那与多数美国南方州一样，共和党在选举中几乎没有支持基础，因此这两轮民主党初选实际上决定了州长人选。主张改革的“反朗派”在吉米·戴维斯领导下再掌权四年。州宪法不允许现任州长萨姆·琼斯连续连任。

en.s: The Bury St Edmunds by-election, 1944 was a parliamentary by-election for the British House of Commons constituency of Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk on 29 February 1944.

zh.t: 1944年贝里圣埃德蒙兹选区补选
zh.s: 1944年2月29日，英国下议院位于萨福克郡的贝里圣埃德蒙兹选区举行议会补选。

en.s: The Battle of Oździutycze (Polish: Bitwa pod Oździutyczami, Ukrainian: Бій під Озютичамі; 29 February 1944) was fought between the “Łuna”, “Trzask” and “Grzyms” battalions in the Polish 27th Volhynian Infantry Division of the Home Army under the command of Stanisław Piaszczyński, against the “Siromantsi” company of the 16th tactical district “Seret” in the 3rd Operational Group “Lysonia” of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army and Kusch Units of the Ukrainian Self–Defense under the command of Hryhoriy Kovalchuk in the Włodzimierz County of the Wołyń Voivodeship.

zh.t: 奥兹久季切之战
zh.s: 奥兹久季切之战（波兰语：Bitwa pod Oździutyczami；乌克兰语：Бій під Озютичамі）发生于1944年2月29日，交战双方为波兰本土军第27沃里尼亚步兵师下属的“Łuna”“Trzask”和“Grzyms”营，以及乌克兰起义军第三作战集群“Lysonia”第16战术区“Seret”的“Siromantsi”连和乌克兰自卫部队Kusch分队。波兰部队由斯坦尼斯瓦夫·皮亚什琴斯基指挥，乌克兰部队由赫里霍里·科瓦尔丘克指挥。战斗发生在沃里尼亚省弗沃济米日县。

en.s: The Battle of Ist was a naval engagement in the Adriatic Sea, between the islands of Škarda and Molat, off the island of Ist, on 29 February 1944. The engagement was fought between two Free French Naval Forces destroyers and a Kriegsmarine force of two corvettes, two torpedo boats and three minesweepers. The German flotilla had been deployed to escort a freighter.

zh.t: 伊斯特岛海战
zh.s: 伊斯特岛海战于1944年2月29日在亚得里亚海展开，地点位于伊斯特岛附近、什卡尔达岛与莫拉特岛之间。交战双方为两艘自由法国海军驱逐舰和德国海军的一支舰队，后者包括两艘轻型护卫舰、两艘鱼雷艇和三艘扫雷舰。德国舰队当时负责护送一艘货船。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: US forces land on Los Negros in the Admiralty Islands
en.s: On February 29, 1944, US forces landed on Los Negros in the Admiralty Islands, now part of Papua New Guinea, opening Operation Brewer. The landing met Japanese resistance and was followed by further fighting.

zh.t: 美军在阿德默勒尔蒂群岛洛斯内格罗斯岛登陆
zh.s: 1944年2月29日，美军在阿德默勒尔蒂群岛的洛斯内格罗斯岛登陆，展开“布鲁尔行动”，地点位于今巴布亚新几内亚。登陆部队遭到日军抵抗，战斗随后继续。

en.s: A shallow earthquake struck near Agadir on Morocco's Atlantic coast late on February 29. Its magnitude was moderate, but severe shaking devastated the city, collapsing homes, hotels, markets and other buildings. Estimates cited in the event article put the death toll between 12,000 and 15,000, with about 12,000 more injured and at least 35,000 left without homes. The districts of Founty, the Kasbah, Yachech and Talborjt suffered especially heavy losses. Broken water mains and destroyed fire stations hampered the immediate response. The disaster remains among the deadliest earthquakes in Moroccan history and prompted a major rescue effort.

zh.t: 地震重创摩洛哥阿加迪尔
zh.s: 2月29日深夜，摩洛哥大西洋沿岸阿加迪尔附近发生浅源地震。震级虽属中等，强烈震动仍重创城市，大量住宅、酒店、市场及其他建筑倒塌。事件文章引用的估计显示，死亡人数为1.2万至1.5万，另有约1.2万人受伤，至少3.5万人无家可归。丰蒂、卡斯巴、亚谢什及塔尔博尔特等区损失尤其惨重。供水主管破裂、消防站被毁，阻碍了最初的救援。这是摩洛哥历史上死亡人数最多的地震之一，灾后展开了大规模救援。

en.s: On 29 February 1964, Wollongong-Kembla held a state by-election for its seat on the New South Wales Legislative Assembly. It was triggered by the resignation of Rex Connor (Labor) to successfully contest the federal seat of Cunningham at the 1963 election.

zh.t: 1964年卧龙岗—肯布拉州议会补选
zh.s: 1964年2月29日，澳大利亚卧龙岗—肯布拉选区举行新南威尔士州立法议会补选。原任工党议员雷克斯·康纳辞职，参加1963年联邦大选，并成功当选坎宁安选区议员，因此留下州议席空缺。

en.s: On Saturday, 29 February 1964, British Eagle International Airlines Flight 802/6 crashed into the Glungezer mountain near Innsbruck, Austria. The aircraft, a Bristol Britannia registered G-AOVO, had taken off from London Heathrow Airport, England, destined for Innsbruck Kranebitten Airport in Austria. All 75 passengers and 8 crew died in the crash.

zh.t: 英国鹰国际航空802/6号班机空难
zh.s: 1964年2月29日星期六，英国鹰国际航空802/6号班机撞上奥地利因斯布鲁克附近的格伦格策尔山。这架注册号G-AOVO的布里斯托尔“不列颠尼亚”客机，从英格兰伦敦希思罗机场起飞，前往奥地利因斯布鲁克克拉内比滕机场。机上75名乘客及8名机组人员全部遇难。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The 1964 Casino state by-election was held on 29 February 1964 to elect the member for Casino in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly, following the resignation of Country Party MP Ian Robinson. Robinson resigned from the Legislative Assembly after winning the seat of Cowper at the 1963 federal election. In a field of four Country candidates and one independent, Richmond Manyweathers retained the seat for the Country Party with 58.48% of the two-candidate-preferred vote.

zh.t: 1964年卡西诺选区补选
zh.s: 1964年2月29日，新南威尔士州举行卡西诺选区补选，以选出该州立法议会议员。此次补选因乡村党议员伊恩·罗宾逊辞职而举行；他在1963年联邦大选中赢得考珀选区席位后辞去了州议会议员职务。四名乡村党候选人和一名独立候选人参选，里士满·曼尼韦瑟斯为乡村党保住席位，两名候选人优先计票率为58.48%。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 15 (Russian: Рейс 15 Аэрофлота Reys 15 Aeroflota) was a passenger flight from Moscow-Domodedovo Airport to Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky Airport with a stopover at Yemelyanovo Airport that crashed on 29 February 1968 en route to Petropavlovsk. All but one aboard the aircraft were killed in the crash.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空15号班机空难
zh.s: 俄罗斯航空15号班机（俄语：Рейс 15 Аэрофлота，罗马字：Reys 15 Aeroflota）是一班从莫斯科多莫杰多沃机场飞往彼得罗巴甫洛夫斯克-堪察加机场的客机，中途停靠叶梅利亚诺沃机场。1968年2月29日，飞机在飞往彼得罗巴甫洛夫斯克途中坠毁，机上人员除一人外全部遇难。

en.s: The 30th annual Berlin International Film Festival was held from 18–29 February 1980. The Golden Bear was jointly awarded to Heartland, directed by Richard Pearce, and Palermo or Wolfsburg, directed by Werner Schroeter. The retrospective was dedicated to American filmmaker Billy Wilder along with a 3D films retrospective. Moritz de Hadeln became the director of the festival and increased the efforts in expansion of Berlin film market.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 第30届柏林国际电影节
zh.s: 第30届柏林国际电影节于1980年2月18日至29日举行。《心地》由理查德·皮尔斯执导，与沃纳·施罗特执导的《巴勒莫或沃尔夫斯堡》共同获得金熊奖。回顾单元聚焦美国电影人比利·怀尔德，并举办3D电影回顾展。莫里茨·德·哈德尔出任电影节总监，并加大了拓展柏林电影市场的力度。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Pierre Trudeau announces that he will step down
en.s: On February 29, 1984, Canadian prime minister Pierre Trudeau announced that he would not lead the Liberal Party into the next election. He remained in office until a successor took over later that year.

zh.t: 皮埃尔·特鲁多宣布将卸任
zh.s: 1984年2月29日，加拿大总理皮埃尔·特鲁多宣布，不再率领自由党参加下一次选举。他并未当天离职，而是在同年稍后由继任者接任。

en.s: SuperBrawl II was the second SuperBrawl professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The event took place on February 29, 1992, from the Milwaukee Auditorium in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Nine matches took place at the event, with one being a dark match. The main event was a singles match between Lex Luger and Sting for the WCW World Heavyweight Championship.

zh.t: 超级争霸赛II
zh.s: “超级争霸赛II”是世界冠军摔角联盟（WCW）举办的第二届“超级争霸赛”职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1992年2月29日在威斯康星州密尔沃基礼堂举行。赛事共九场比赛，其中一场不向付费转播观众播出。主赛是莱克斯·卢格与斯汀争夺WCW世界重量级冠军的单打赛。

en.s: An independence referendum was held in the Socialist Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina between 29 February and 1 March 1992, following the first free elections of 1990 and the rise of ethnic tensions that eventually led to the breakup of Yugoslavia. Independence was strongly favoured by Muslim and Bosnian Croat voters while Bosnian Serbs boycotted the referendum or were prevented from participating by Bosnian Serb authorities.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1992年波黑独立公投
zh.s: 1992年2月29日至3月1日，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那社会主义共和国举行独立公投。此前，该国于1990年举行首次自由选举，族群紧张局势日益加剧，最终导致南斯拉夫解体。穆斯林和波斯尼亚克罗地亚族选民强烈支持独立；波斯尼亚塞族选民则抵制公投，或被波斯尼亚塞族当局阻止参与。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Faucett Perú Flight 251 crashes near Arequipa
en.s: Faucett Perú Flight 251, a domestic passenger service from Lima toward Tacna, crashed while approaching its scheduled stop at Arequipa on February 29. The Boeing 737 struck hills near the airport during a nighttime approach in rain and mist. All 123 people aboard, including six crew members, died. Investigators later found that an incorrect altimeter setting had led the crew to believe the aircraft was higher than it actually was. The disaster became the deadliest aviation accident on Peruvian soil. The flight's route, crash location, casualty count and investigation are documented in the dedicated accident article and its cited official report.

zh.t: 秘鲁福塞特航空251号班机在阿雷基帕附近坠毁
zh.s: 2月29日，秘鲁福塞特航空251号班机从利马飞往塔克纳，在接近预定经停点阿雷基帕时坠毁。这架波音737在雨雾中的夜间进近阶段，撞上机场附近的山丘，机上123人全部遇难，包括6名机组人员。调查人员后来发现，高度表设置错误，使机组误以为飞机比实际位置更高。这成为秘鲁境内死亡人数最多的航空事故。专门的事故文章及其引用的官方报告，记录了航线、坠机地点、伤亡数字和调查情况。

en.s: The siege of Sarajevo (Serbo-Croatian: Опсада Сарајева, Opsada Sarajeva) was a prolonged military blockade of Sarajevo, the capital of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina, during the ethnically charged Bosnian War. The city was initially besieged by the Yugoslav People's Army, before they were replaced by elements of the newly-formed Army of Republika Srpska.
en.n: The Siege of Sarajevo officially ends.

zh.t: 萨拉热窝围城战
zh.s: 萨拉热窝围城战（塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语：Опсада Сарајева，罗马字：Opsada Sarajeva）是波黑战争期间对波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那共和国首都萨拉热窝实施的一场长期军事封锁。围城最初由南斯拉夫人民军实施，之后由新成立的塞族共和国军部分部队接替。
zh.n: 萨拉热窝围城战正式结束。

en.t: Jean-Bertrand Aristide leaves Haiti amid a rebellion
en.s: President Jean-Bertrand Aristide left Haiti as an armed rebellion and political crisis threatened the capital, Port-au-Prince. His departure followed weeks of fighting during which rebels had taken several cities. The circumstances remain contested: Aristide said he had been forced out, while United States officials maintained that he had resigned voluntarily. Boniface Alexandre, the chief justice of Haiti's Supreme Court, became interim president. International forces subsequently deployed as the country faced continuing instability. The episode is commonly described as the 2004 Haitian coup, but a careful account distinguishes the documented departure and transfer of office from competing explanations of how they occurred.

zh.t: 让-贝特朗·阿里斯蒂德在叛乱中离开海地
zh.s: 武装叛乱与政治危机威胁首都太子港之际，总统让-贝特朗·阿里斯蒂德离开海地。此前数周持续交战，叛军已占领数座城市。他离开的具体情形至今存在争议：阿里斯蒂德称自己是被迫离境，美国官员则坚称他自愿辞职。海地最高法院院长博尼法斯·亚历山大出任临时总统，国际部队随后进驻，但国家仍持续动荡。这段事件通常被称为2004年海地政变。叙述时应区分已有记录的离境与权力交接事实，以及各方对其过程提出的不同解释。

en.s: The Hamburg state election, 2004 was conducted on 29 February 2004 to elect members to the Hamburgische Bürgerschaft (state and city legislature) of Hamburg. It was the 18th legislative period of the Hamburg Parliament.

zh.t: 2004年汉堡州议会选举
zh.s: 2004年2月29日，汉堡举行选举，选出第18届州兼市议会的议员。

en.s: The 76th Academy Awards ceremony, presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS), honored the best films of 2003 and took place on February 29, 2004, at the Kodak Theatre in Hollywood, Los Angeles. During the ceremony, AMPAS presented Academy Awards (commonly referred to as Oscars) in 24 categories. The ceremony, televised in the United States by ABC, was produced by Joe Roth and was directed by Louis J.

zh.t: 第76届奥斯卡金像奖
zh.s: 第76届奥斯卡颁奖典礼由美国电影艺术与科学学院举办，于2004年2月29日在洛杉矶好莱坞柯达剧院举行，表彰2003年的优秀电影。典礼颁发24个类别的奥斯卡奖，由美国广播公司在美国进行电视转播，乔·罗斯担任制作人。原文在导演姓名“路易斯·J.”处中断。

en.s: The 2004 Football League Cup final (known as the Carling Cup final for sponsorship reasons) was a football match that took place on 29 February 2004 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff. It was the final match of the 2003–04 Football League Cup, the 44th edition of the Football League Cup, a competition for the 92 teams in the Premier League and The Football League.

zh.t: 2004年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛
zh.s: 2004年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛因赞助原因又称嘉玲杯决赛，于2004年2月29日在加的夫千年球场举行。这是2003—04赛季联赛杯的最后一场比赛，也是该项由英超和英格兰足球联赛92支球队参加的赛事第44届。

en.t: Aristide leaves Haiti as his presidency ends
en.s: On February 29, 2004, Jean-Bertrand Aristide left Haiti as his presidency ended amid an armed rebellion and international pressure. The circumstances of his departure remain disputed: Aristide said he had been forced out, while US officials denied that account.

zh.t: 阿里斯蒂德离开海地，总统任期结束
zh.s: 2004年2月29日，在武装叛乱和国际压力下，让-贝特朗·阿里斯蒂德离开海地，总统任期随之结束。对于离境经过，双方说法不同：阿里斯蒂德称自己被迫离开，美国官员则予以否认。

en.s: On 29 February 2012, the Bahraini and Indonesian national association football teams faced each other in a qualifying match for the 2014 FIFA World Cup. The match was played at the Bahrain National Stadium in Riffa, Bahrain. The match ended as the biggest win for Bahrain, and the biggest defeat for Indonesia. This match is known for a FIFA match-fixing investigation afterwards.

zh.t: 巴林10比0印度尼西亚
zh.s: 2012年2月29日，巴林和印度尼西亚国家足球队在里法的巴林国家体育场进行2014年国际足联世界杯预选赛。巴林以10比0获胜，创下该队最大胜差，也是印度尼西亚队最大失利。这场比赛后来引发国际足联对假球的调查。

en.t: A suicide bombing strikes a funeral in Muqdadiyah
en.s: On February 29, 2016, a suicide bombing struck a funeral for a Shiite militia fighter in Muqdadiyah, Iraq. Reports described dozens of people killed and injured; casualty totals changed as information emerged.

zh.t: 穆格达迪耶一场葬礼遭自杀式爆炸袭击
zh.s: 2016年2月29日，伊拉克穆格达迪耶一场什叶派民兵成员的葬礼遭到自杀式爆炸袭击。报道指多人死伤，随着消息更新，伤亡统计有所变化。

en.s: The 2016 Khanasir offensive was a military operation conducted by ISIL and Jund al-Aqsa, during the Syrian Civil War, with the aim of cutting the Syrian government's only supply route to the northern part of the Aleppo Governorate, which runs through the town of Khanasir.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2016年哈纳西尔攻势
zh.s: 2016年哈纳西尔攻势是叙利亚内战期间伊斯兰国和阿克萨旅发动的一次军事行动，目标是切断叙利亚政府通往阿勒颇省北部的唯一补给线，该路线经过哈纳西尔镇。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The United States and Taliban sign an agreement in Doha
en.s: Representatives of the United States and the Taliban signed the Agreement for Bringing Peace to Afghanistan in Doha, Qatar, on February 29. The signed document itself records the place and date. It set out commitments concerning foreign troop withdrawal and the use of Afghan territory by militant groups.

zh.t: 美国与塔利班在多哈签署协议
zh.s: 2月29日，美国与塔利班代表在卡塔尔多哈签署《为阿富汗带来和平的协议》。签署文件载明了地点和日期，内容包括外国军队撤离，以及防止武装组织利用阿富汗领土的相关承诺。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Slovakia on 29 February 2020 to elect all 150 members of the National Council. The populist Ordinary People and Independent Personalities–NOVA–Christian Union–Change from Below (OĽaNO–NOVA–KÚ–ZZ) party emerged as the largest parliamentary group, winning 53 seats. The ruling coalition comprising Direction – Social Democracy (Smer), the Slovak National Party (SNS), and Most–Híd, led by Prime Minister Peter Pellegrini of Smer, won only 38, with both the SNS and Most–Híd losing their parliamentary representation.

zh.t: 2020年斯洛伐克议会选举
zh.s: 斯洛伐克于2020年2月29日举行选举，改选国民议会全部150个议席。民粹主义的“普通人与独立人格—新多数派—基督教联盟—自下而上变革”联盟赢得53席，成为最大议会党团。方向—社会民主党的总理彼得·佩列格里尼领导的执政联盟，仅获得38席；联盟中的斯洛伐克民族党与桥党均失去议会代表资格。

en.s: The 2020 FA Women's League Cup final was the ninth final of the FA Women's League Cup, England's secondary cup competition for women's football teams and its primary League Cup tournament. It took place on 29 February 2020 at the City Ground, and was contested by Arsenal and Chelsea. Arsenal had competed in all but one (2016) of the previous finals, winning five.

zh.t: 2020年英格兰女子联赛杯决赛
zh.s: 2020年英格兰女子联赛杯决赛于2月29日在城市球场举行，由阿森纳对阵切尔西。这是第九届决赛；该赛事是英格兰女子足球第二重要的杯赛，也是主要的联赛杯赛事。此前历届决赛中，阿森纳只缺席过2016年，并五次夺冠。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Benavidez vs. Figueiredo
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Benavidez vs. Figueiredo (also known as UFC Fight Night 169 and UFC on ESPN+ 27) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on February 29, 2020 at Chartway Arena in Norfolk, Virginia, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：贝纳维德斯对菲格雷多
zh.s: “UFC格斗之夜：贝纳维德斯对菲格雷多”，又称UFC格斗之夜169及UFC on ESPN+ 27，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2020年2月29日在美国弗吉尼亚州诺福克的Chartway竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2020 South Carolina Democratic presidential primary took place on February 29, 2020, and was the fourth nominating contest in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election. The South Carolina primary was an open primary and awarded 64 delegates to the 2020 Democratic National Convention, of which 54 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2020年南卡罗来纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年南卡罗来纳州民主党总统初选于2月29日举行，是该党当届总统候选人提名程序中的第四场竞逐。这场开放式初选涉及参加2020年民主党全国代表大会的64名代表，其中54名须根据初选结果分配并支持相应候选人。

en.s: BTC 9: Rampage is a mixed martial arts event produced by the BTC Fight Promotions that took place on February 29, 2020 at The Kitchener Memorial Auditorium (The Aud) in Kitchener, Ontario.

zh.t: BTC 9：横冲直撞
zh.s: “BTC 9：横冲直撞”是BTC格斗推广公司举办的综合格斗赛事，于2020年2月29日在加拿大安大略省基奇纳的基奇纳纪念礼堂，简称“The Aud”，举行。

en.s: A by-election in the seat of Johnston in the Northern Territory was held on 29 February 2020, following the resignation of Ken Vowles, the MLA for Johnston, on 31 January 2020. Vowles was first elected in the 2012 Northern Territory general election, winning 45% of first preference votes and 55.7% of the two-party-preferred vote.

zh.t: 2020年约翰斯顿选区补选
zh.s: 2020年2月29日，澳大利亚北领地约翰斯顿选区举行补选。此前，代表约翰斯顿选区的议员肯·沃尔斯于2020年1月31日辞职。沃尔斯于2012年北领地大选中首次当选，首选票得票率为45%，两党优先计票率为55.7%。

en.s: Gateway To Honor was a professional wrestling livestreaming event promoted by Ring of Honor (ROH). It took place on February 29, 2020, from the Family Arena in St. Charles, Missouri and was streamed live on ROH's streaming service Honor Club.

zh.t: 荣誉之门（2020年）
zh.s: “荣誉之门”是荣誉之环（ROH）主办的一场职业摔角网络直播赛事，于2020年2月29日在美国密苏里州圣查尔斯的家庭竞技场举行，并通过ROH的Honor Club流媒体服务进行直播。

en.t: Malaysia’s king appoints Muhyiddin Yassin prime minister
en.s: On February 29, 2020, Malaysia’s king appointed Muhyiddin Yassin as the country’s eighth prime minister during a political crisis. His swearing-in took place the following day.

zh.t: 马来西亚最高元首任命慕尤丁为总理
zh.s: 2020年2月29日，马来西亚最高元首在政治危机期间任命慕尤丁为第八任总理。宣誓就职仪式于次日举行。

en.s: On February 29, 2020, Glory held the Glory 75: Utrecht kickboxing event at Central Studios in Utrecht, Netherlands.

zh.t: Glory 75踢拳赛事在乌得勒支举行
zh.s: 2020年2月29日，Glory在荷兰乌得勒支的Central Studios举办Glory 75：乌得勒支踢拳赛事。

en.t: The United States and the Taliban sign the Doha agreement
en.s: On February 29, 2020, US envoy Zalmay Khalilzad and Taliban representatives signed an agreement in Doha, Qatar, providing for the withdrawal of US and allied forces from Afghanistan under specified conditions. The withdrawal was not completed that day.

zh.t: 美国与塔利班签署多哈协议
zh.s: 2020年2月29日，美国特使扎尔梅·哈利勒扎德与塔利班代表在卡塔尔多哈签署协议，约定美国及盟军在一定条件下撤离阿富汗。撤军并未于当天完成。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Rochdale was held on 29 February 2024, following the death of incumbent Labour MP Sir Tony Lloyd. It was won by George Galloway of the Workers Party of Britain, who received 40% of the vote and overturned a 9,668 vote Labour majority from the 2019 general election.

zh.t: 2024年罗奇代尔选区补选
zh.s: 英国罗奇代尔选区于2024年2月29日举行议会补选，填补工党议员托尼·劳埃德爵士去世留下的空缺。英国工人党的乔治·加洛韦以40%的选票获胜，夺走工党在2019年大选中曾以9668票领先优势赢得的议席。

en.t: Palestinians seeking food aid are killed near Gaza City
en.s: More than 100 Palestinians died during an aid delivery near Gaza City on February 29. Crowds had gathered around trucks carrying flour and other supplies. The incident became known as the Flour Massacre. A United Nations inquiry later examined the deaths and the conflicting accounts of what happened.

zh.t: 加沙城附近领取粮食援助的巴勒斯坦人遇难
zh.s: 2月29日，加沙城附近发放援助物资时，一百多名巴勒斯坦人死亡。当时人群聚集在运送面粉及其他补给的卡车周围。事件后来被称为“面粉惨案”。联合国调查后来审视了这些死亡及各方对事发经过的不同说法。

en.s: Intimidation Games (2024) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW). It took place on February 29, 2024, at the Melrose Ballroom in Queens, New York, and streamed live on Triller TV. It was the fourth event under the Intimidation Games chronology. Additional matches were taped for MLW's "Once Upon A Time In New York" special, which aired on BeIN Sports USA and MLW's YouTube channel on March 16.

zh.t: 威慑游戏2024
zh.s: “威慑游戏2024”是摔角大联盟（MLW）举办的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2024年2月29日在纽约皇后区的梅尔罗斯舞厅举行，由Triller TV直播。这是该系列的第四届。现场还录制了额外比赛，用于3月16日在BeIN Sports美国频道及MLW的YouTube频道播出的特别节目《纽约往事》。
